## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 16, 2026 - Nov 26, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Heather4132_, Nov 26, 2026, 1/5: "Part of the premium package comes with Recipe Discovery where you can hit an icon on their suggested recipes (it looks like a bookmark) so you can refer to them later. This feature is available only on the phone, not the desktop. The problem is if you bookmark a lot of recipes (more than a page) and then try to “see all” of those, the app crashes and boots you. I have been trying to get this fixed but the technical help available is just useless AI bots that regurgitate canned responses. The AI will respond but with unhelpful information that doesn’t address your problem. It’s very frustrating. The app already doesn’t have a search feature for their suggested recipes (another thing that sucks) so to not be able to see your bookmarked recipes really makes the Recipe Discovery almost useless. (This is not about creating your own recipes or meals, the issue is about trying to see their suggested recipes that you’ve saved, just to be clear). So this app charges a lot for premium but a major feature is broken."
            2. _eBayX_, Nov 23, 2026, 1/5: "Unfortunately, the app is broken and will not connect with Garmin Connect since its new updated version. I submitted a message and was told it is broken for the foreseeable future. Don’t recommend at this time."
            3. _Guillidou_, Nov 21, 2026, 1/5: "This app was fantastic until they decided to update it to a new version recently. Now it just crashes all the time. Sometimes you can’t even log in. Some of the features are gone from the mobile up, like creating a meal from what you have logged as your lunch etc in the diary or completing your nutrition for the day to check how many weeks to lose some weight. I do not recommend this app anymore unless they go back to the way it was before :("
